privacy.text:
In order to customize your experience, we will access, collect, use, and process some of your information, including the personal information within your profile.

Your Personal information will be handled in accordance with the Liberty Mutual Insurance Privacy Policy. In order to move forward, please click Agree and Continue.
privacy.title: Data Privacy

uploadResumeModal.title: Welcome to the {company_name} Career Center
uploadResumeModal.subtitle: Upload your resume to have jobs recommended that may align with your skills.
uploadResumeModal.disclaimer: **Uploading your resume is not a formal application for employment**

perks.description: Our compensation programs are designed to deliver above-market pay if you perform well, and significantly above that for exceptional performance over time. Virtually every employee is eligible for some type of variable incentive pay in addition to his or her base pay.
perks.title: Competitive Compensation

perks.description: We understand the role work-life balance plays in your ability to stay energized and engaged. So we place an emphasis on regular hours, flex scheduling, and generous time off through paid holidays, vacation days, and more.
perks.title: Flexible Work Arrangements

perks.description:
We help you prepare for the future through our 401(k) plan.  Our plan provides a 100% match for up to 5%
per pay period and an additional 3% annual match for all employees employed on 12/31 each year.
perks.title: Top-Notch Retirement Plan

perks.description: From regular coaching and planning to paid training, licensing, and tuition reimbursement for approved courses, we’re dedicated to your continued growth, because we know it leads to continued success
perks.title: Career Development

perks.description: You’ll have access to comprehensive health, dental, and vision coverage, as well as a host of other insurance and wellness benefits—including progressive parental benefits and support.
perks.title: Health & Wellness

perks.description: Liberty Mutual fosters an inclusive workplace where employees and customers of all backgrounds feel valued, supported, and empowered to contribute their best.
perks.title: Commitment to an inclusive environment

perks.description: Your ability to prioritize the needs of our customers will always be embraced and appreciated.
perks.title: Customer first mentality

perks.description: Our teams are constantly experimenting with new ways to protect our customers.
perks.title: Continuous improvement and innovation

positions.job_description: Build and maintain detailed cash flow models for CRE loans and underlying properties, including sensitivity and downside scenario analysis, to evaluate credit risk and relative value. Conduct property, market, and sponsor due diligence, including review of rent rolls, operating statements, appraisals, third-party reports, and market comparables. Prepare investment memoranda and presentations that clearly articulate the investment thesis, key risks and mitigants, and proposed structure. Support the structuring and negotiation of loan terms and documentation alongside senior team members, legal counsel, and internal partners. Track the performance of existing investments, monitor covenant compliance and market conditions, and proactively flag emerging risks to the team. Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Real Estate, Accounting, or a related field; progress toward the CFA or a master's degree a plus. 2-4+ years of experience in real estate investment banking, or real estate private equity, with direct exposure to underwriting and transaction execution. Advanced Excel financial modeling skills Strong written and verbal communication skills; sound credit judgment and strong attention to detail; ability to manage multiple transactions simultaneously and work independently; demonstrated interest in real estate credit markets. Demonstrates strong AI literacy and uses AI-enabled tools to enhance speed, accuracy, and insight generation while maintaining sound judgment and compliance with governance standards
